ios.desc:
Elvebredd is an Adopt Me Trading Value Calculator Designed to help players trade pets and items with confidence. Get fast, accurate, and easy to understand values to make the fair trades and avoid losses.

Wether you are new or experienced, Elvebredd gives you the tools to compare pets, check trade fairness, and stay updated with the latest Adopt Me values-All in one place.

Key Features:
Adopt Me Value Calculator – Instantly compare pets and items to evaluate fair trades.
Trading Center – Discover, post, and accept trades with other players.
Updated Values List – Access regularly updated pet and item values.
Value History Charts – Track price trends and value changes over time.

Upgrade to Pro To Enjoy These Extra:
• Ad-Free — enjoy the entire app with no ads.
• Live Market Analytics — real trade activity across the app: what's hot, what's being offered, Win/Fair/Lose stats, the busiest trading hours, and detailed value movements.
• WFL with AMVGG Values — instantly check if a trade is a Win, Fair, or Lose using AMVGG values.
• Boost Your Trades — feature your trades at the top so more players see them.
• Pet Aging & Growing Tracker — follow your pets' growth and get reminders.
• Scam Protection — extra in-app warnings to help you trade safely.
• Higher Trade Limits — post more trades every day.
• Saved Trades — bookmark trades to revisit later.
• Pro Badge & Custom Profile — stand out in the community.


Real-time Chat – Discuss trades, negotiate offers, and connect with players.
User Accounts – Send offers, manage trades, and stay connected easily.
Moreover, compare your Elvebredd trade with AMVGG values to instantly check whether the trade is a Win, Fair, or Lose (WFL). With AMVGG integration now you can easily analyze and compare trades more accurately.

Elvebredd makes Adopt Me trading smarter by providing accurate value data, market trends, and trade insights so you can win more trades.
Also its made for Adopt Me players and is not affiliated with, endorsed, by Roblox or Adopt Me!.
